label: 落下溶岩弾
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Transparent FOUR-frame battle VFX sheet EXACT 2x2 equal cells, order top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right. one falling diagonal down-left black basalt lava bomb with glowing cracks, white-hot core, long tail toward upper-right. Frame1 onset at 25% intensity, frame2 energetic expansion, frame3 spectacular maximum impact, frame4 dying fragments. Refined fantasy JRPG pixel art, chunky crisp clusters and stepped edges, dark defined contour, high contrast, dramatic late-game power. No character, weapon prop, landscape, solid floor, text, labels, grid, checkerboard, watermark, photographic smoke or airbrush. Actual transparent alpha including hollow centers. Each full effect in its own cell with 12% clear padding; no clipping or overlap. Local 0..1024 coordinates: fixed center (512,512), trail points RIGHT for left-moving projectiles. Keep size consistent, only purposeful expansion varies. Palette orange/gold/white heat with red-black edges.
reviewStatus: all source frames visually reviewed; playback and runtime acceptance pending

observations: 黒い溶岩塊が左下へ落ち、右上に尾が伸びる。
issues: 飛翔用なのに3コマ目で爆散する。落下のループと着弾エフェクトを分離する。
発生→最大衝撃→収束という共通指定を、飛翔の脈動・軌道に修正する。
